nodes.label: Prosecutor investigation 1001-14.Ds.16.2026 (TK judges denied work and pay)
Maciej Świrski (ex-PFN board member, ex-KRRiT head)

edges.relation: filed a criminal notification (dated 28 Sep 2026, received 29 Sep) accusing him of exceeding his powers by assigning TK panels against art. 38(1) of the TK Act, Jan to 7 Sep 2026 (art. 231 kk); an accusation, not a finding
his notification was joined to this existing investigation (prosecutor statement, 1 Oct 2026)
investigates alleged failure by TK officials to give four judges work, pay and cases (art. 231 §1 and 218 §1a kk); the four are not named
handled by the prosecutors' team on the KRS and its appointees, set up by his order No. 30/2025 (12 Sep 2025)

30 Sep 2025: asked the TK to allow his prosecution (Pegasus team No. 3); prosecutors allege that as National Prosecutor (Jul 2020 to Jun 2021) he directed unauthorised oversight of Giertych surveillance and copying of the material
TK General Assembly, 15 Oct 2025: all 10 voting judges refused consent to prosecute him; prosecutors say only 3 had read the classified files and the resolution has no legal effect

charged 14 Jul 2026 by Rzeszów regional prosecutors, with fellow board member Cezary J., with abuse of power over the 2017 'Sprawiedliwe Sądy' campaign; alleged damage to PFN at least PLN 8.4m; both deny
